coder.role: Godot GDScript aur Blender Python (bpy) code likhna

lead.role: Team lead: bade kaam ko chhote kaamon mein todna, baaki agents ko baantna, unka kaam review karna

blender_tech.role: Blender 5.3 ke bpy Python scripts likhna jo 3D models/maps banate hain

level_designer.role: Jungle/lakdi wali duniya ka map aur level ka dhaancha banana

animator.role: Darwaze, ped hilna jaise animations (keyframes) banana

reviewer.role: Code, models aur animations mein bugs/kamiyan dhoondhna

art_director.role: Game ka look/style, rang aur lakdi-jungle theme tay karna

props_artist.role: Ped, lattha, jhopdi, pul, saman jaise lakdi ke props ke Blender models

gameplay_designer.role: Gameplay: player ke kaam, dushman, items, rules aur quests
